description: Request a free HLA-Verify API key. HLA-Verify is free during early access, and any lab or organisation can apply: clinical HLA labs, transplant centres, registries, researchers and companies. Ask before calling: it records the address, institution and use case you give it; use the user's work email address. The institution is verified and, if it is approved, a free Lab-tier key (10,000 calls/day, 5,000 typings per call) is emailed, usually within a few hours. Applications from personal email addresses are reviewed by hand and take longer; approval is not guaranteed. Re-applying with the same address is safe (status already_recorded) and never overwrites an application that has already been decided. Questions: hello@hlaverify.com.

email.description: The applicant's email address. The approval code is sent here.

expected_volume.description: Rough call or typing volume, e.g. 'about 20,000 typings a month' (optional).

institution.description: University, hospital, institute or nonprofit the work is done at.

source.description: Where the application came from, e.g. mcp (optional).

use_case.description: What the research or teaching is, and what the API would be used for. This is what the decision is made on, so be specific. No patient details.

name: research_access

message.description: What to tell the user, including that approval is by hand and not instant.

ok.description: Always true; a rejected application comes back as an error result.

release.description: IPD-IMGT/HLA release every verdict was computed against.

status.description: already_recorded: this address already has an application on file. Both are success; do not retry.
